2. This Misc. Appeal under Section 173(1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is preferred feeling aggrieved by award dated 28-02-2018 in MCC No. 400133/14 by 2nd Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Betul for compensation of Rs. one lac.

entities.text: 2nd Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Betul
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Facts in brief are that the appellant sustained injuries in motor accident dated 02-09-2013 at 8:00 AM.
He was on the way to office of Nagar Pallik Betul where he was working as temporary peon.
At that time, the appellant was aged 40 years and was getting salary of Rs. 8200/-.
He was discontinued from his job due to injuries by negligent driving of motor-cycle No. MP-48-MH-3508 by respondent No.1, owned by respondent No. 2 and insured by respondent No.3.

He was treated in Primary Health Centre at Betul and Mamta Maternity Fracture Hospital,Betul and privately by Kishor Pawar vs Jitesh Patel on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147303429/
1
doctor Puneet Shrivastava.
Despite treatment, he got permanently physical disability to the extent of 45%.
So, he filed a claim for compensation of Rs. 13,47,800/-.
4. Respondent Nos. 1 and 2 contested the claim denying the accident and breach of policy conditions also and respondent No. 3 contested the claim.
5. The Tribunal framed issues and recorded the evidence of appellant- Kishor Pawar as (PW-1) and Dr. P. Chourasia as (PW-2) and admitted documents as Ex. P/1 to Ex.P/71.

Appreciating the evidence, the tribunal found proved that the appellant sustained injuries in motor accident due to negligence of respondent No.1 and the vehicle was owned by respondent No. 2 and insured by the respondent No.3.

He also found proved that the appellant was aged 45 years at the time of accident and he was earning Rs. 6,000/- per month and rejecting the claim of disability of 45%, the tribunal concluded that the appellant got only 10% permanent physical disability and awarded a total sum of Rs. 1,86,212/- in the following heads:-
 (a) Loss of future income : Rs. 1,00,
 (b) Medical expenses : Rs. 48,4  (c) Attendant charges : Rs. 17,0  (c) Nutritional diet, mental and : Rs  physical pain, transportation  and other heads --------------------------------------------------------------------------
Total : Rs. 1,86, 212/-
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
6.
Feeling dissatisfied with the award, this appeal is preferred on the ground that the disability has not been considered properly.
Other heads are not compensated.

7. Heard.
8.
Learned counsel for the respondent No.3 opposed the prayer.
9. Considered paragraph-19 of the award, re-appreciated Ex. P/27 and P/28, the finding of the tribunal regarding 10% disability does not call for any interference.
10. The Tribunal has not considered the enhancement of 25% in the head of future prospect.
So, a total of Rs. 25,000/- compensation is enhanced in the head of loss of future income.

sentences.text: Considering the fact that Tribunal has recorded the finding that screws are fixed in the leg of victim then he has to be awarded for future treatment.
So, an amount of Rs. 20,000/- is awarded in the head of future medical expenses.

Head of nutritious diet and mental and physical pain,
transportation is awarded collectively on the lower side.
In paragraph-19 of the award, the period of hospitalisation is mentioned as 20 days.
He was fixed with plates and screws and he undergone surgeries.
A total of 5 months of loss of work is inferred from the record.

So, a total compensation of Rs. 30,000/- is awarded for the loss of 5 months income during treatment and compensation of Rs.
15,000/- is enhanced in the head of nutritious diet, mental and physical pain, transportation and other heads.

12. The Appeal is partly allowed and a total of Rs. 90,000/- is further enhanced with interest @ 9%
per annum from the date of application i.e. 10-09- 2014.

(GAJENDRA SINGH) JUDGE PG Kishor Pawar vs Jitesh Patel on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147303429/
